requirements: R1: Read framework.yaml from the working directory (path configurable via --framework flag, default: framework.yaml)
R2: Extract all module IDs from the modules list
R3: For each module, validate all depends_on entries are valid module IDs — flag any missing
R4: For each shared.references entry, validate all consumers are valid module IDs — flag any missing
R5: For each shared.infrastructure entry, validate all consumers are valid module IDs — flag any missing
R6: Print summary: total modules checked, total shared files checked, total violations found
R7: Print each violation with: type (depends_on | consumer), source module or file path, invalid reference
R8: Exit code 0 if zero violations; exit code 1 if one or more violations
success_criteria: Script runs on framework.yaml with exit code 0 and reports zero violations
Script correctly flags a seeded invalid depends_on reference when tested with a modified input
Script correctly flags a seeded invalid consumer reference when tested with a modified input
failure_modes: framework.yaml not found: print clear error, exit code 2
framework.yaml malformed YAML: print parse error with line number, exit code 2
Module has depends_on referencing non-existent ID: violation reported, exit code 1
Shared file has consumer referencing non-existent module ID: violation reported, exit code 1
